title: Withheld Shares by How Far Ahead of Arrival Rooms Are Given Up
content:
The withheld share on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation is settled from the whole days lying between the handling date and the arrival date.

## The schedule of shares

| Whole days between the handling date and the arrival date | Withheld share |
| --- | --- |
| 30 or more | 0 percent |
| 29 to 8 | 25 percent |
| 7 to 2 | 50 percent |
| fewer than 2 | the flat cancellation share the rate plan booked carries |

## The flat cancellation share each plan carries

| Rate plan | Flat cancellation share, percent |
| --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 100 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 50 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 25 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 10 |
| Member Flex Rate | 10 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 20 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 35 |

## The bands at their edges

| Whole days to arrival | Band reached | Withheld share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 31 | 30 or more | 0 percent |
| 30 | 30 or more | 0 percent |
| 29 | 29 to 8 | 25 percent |
| 8 | 29 to 8 | 25 percent |
| 7 | 7 to 2 | 50 percent |
| 2 | 7 to 2 | 50 percent |
| 1 | fewer than 2 | the flat share of the plan booked |
| 0 | fewer than 2 | the flat share of the plan booked |

Each band opens at the figure named and runs up to the day before the next band opens: 30 days is inside the first band and 29 days is not; 8 days is inside the second and 7 days is not; 2 days is inside the third and 1 day is not.

## Points of judgement

*A guest on the Suite Flexible Rate giving up rooms 9 whole days before arrival.* Nine days falls in the band of 29 to 8 whole days, so the withheld share is 25 percent. Its flat share of 20 percent is not reached, because that share governs only where fewer than 2 whole days lie between the handling date and the arrival date.

*A guest on the Non-Refundable Saver Rate giving up rooms on the day of arrival.* Nothing lies between the handling date and the arrival date, so fewer than 2 whole days do; the withheld share is that plan's flat share of 100 percent.

*A guest on the Standard Flexible Rate giving up rooms 45 whole days before arrival.* Forty-five days reaches 30 or more, so the withheld share is 0 percent, not that plan's flat share of 10 percent.
